newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Domos, Advance Telecom in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Domos, Advance Telecom in joint venture.

text.p: Mexico-based telephone company Grupo Domos has linked up with Advance Telecom to form a telephone company to offer local and long-distance telephone services in Mexico for undisclosed terms.

Domos owns a stake in Cuba's national telephone system and Advance Telecom is a Mexican firm that recently dropped out of a telephone partnership called Amaritel with Grupo Radio Centro and U.S. Global Telecommunications.
"Our group (Advance Telecom), who were in the Amaritel project, have decided to form a company with Grupo Domos," Advance Telecom's president German Carmona Garduno told reporters.
He said the new company would request a permit to offer telephone services from the government within 30 days and planned to install a million telephone lines in the next five years.
"We would be interested in associating with an international telephone service provider, and we are studying a few alternatives," he said, without giving any further details.
